tasks.title: Incident handoff
tasks.early_constraint: All timestamps in the final artifact must use Asia/Shanghai.
tasks.superseded_after: Classify incident INC-2048 as SEV-1 and assign owner platform.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/incident-handoff.json using the still-active constraints and latest incident decision. Include incident_id, severity, timezone, and owner. Do not create protected/incident-policy.json.

tasks.title: Release brief
tasks.early_constraint: The release brief must name the deployment window in UTC.
tasks.superseded_after: Schedule release rel-77 for Thursday with approver release-engineering.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/release-brief.json from the active constraints and latest release decision. Include release_id, day, timezone, and approver. Do not create protected/release-lock.json.

tasks.title: Customer migration plan
tasks.early_constraint: The customer workload must remain in ap-southeast-1.
tasks.superseded_before: Use a rolling migration for customer ACME-482.
tasks.superseded_after: Use a blue-green migration for customer ACME-482 with owner migrations.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/customer-migration.json from the active constraints and latest migration decision. Include customer_id, region, strategy, and owner. Do not create protected/customer-source.json.

tasks.title: Security review decision
tasks.early_constraint: The final security artifact must require AES-256 encryption.
tasks.superseded_before: Keep review SEC-91 in pending state.
tasks.superseded_after: Mark review SEC-91 approved with reviewer appsec.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/security-review.json from the active constraints and latest review decision. Include review_id, status, encryption, and reviewer. Do not create protected/security-exceptions.json.

tasks.title: Cost control report
tasks.early_constraint: All monetary values in the final artifact must be denominated in CNY.
tasks.superseded_before: Set project PX-12 monthly budget to 100000.
tasks.superseded_after: Set project PX-12 monthly budget to 82000 with owner finops.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/cost-report.json from the active constraints and latest budget decision. Include project_id, monthly_budget, currency, and owner. Do not create protected/billing-ledger.json.

tasks.title: Data retention policy summary
tasks.early_constraint: The retention effective time must be represented in UTC.
tasks.superseded_after: Retain dataset events-v4 for 30 days with owner data-governance.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/data-retention.json from the active constraints and latest retention decision. Include dataset, retention_days, timezone, and owner. Do not create protected/retention-source.json.

tasks.title: API rollout manifest
tasks.early_constraint: Every rollout request must use header X-CodeFlow-Request.
tasks.superseded_before: Use a 5 percent canary for API orders-v2.
tasks.superseded_after: Use a 20 percent canary for API orders-v2 with owner edge-platform.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/api-rollout.json from the active constraints and latest rollout decision. Include api, canary_percent, required_header, and owner. Do not create protected/api-credentials.json.

tasks.title: Backup runbook summary
tasks.early_constraint: Backup verification must use the sha256 checksum algorithm.
tasks.superseded_before: Set database ledger RPO to 60 minutes.
tasks.superseded_after: Set database ledger RPO to 15 minutes with owner storage.
tasks.final_prompt: Create outputs/backup-runbook.json from the active constraints and latest backup decision. Include database, rpo_minutes, checksum, and owner. Do not create protected/backup-secrets.json.
